title: Incision
direction: Letter-led: a lowercase m scored by one precise diagonal cut, one half shifted
rationale: Cut-and-shift on the initial: a clean incision as the maker's mark and the sign of exact work; wordmark repeats the cut in one letter.

sketchReview.notes: Third pass, still none. s9-s11 read as an m with a nick or a stray triangle; the cut is a small detail that vanishes at 16 px and is the generic bitten/notched-letter device. s11 drifts toward r+n. Distinctiveness about 4, memorability about 5; no developed variant is likely to reach 7. Drop the direction; try a concept whose idea is structural, not a surface cut.
